facts.text: Appeal item: 1-hour fire-rated construction within 3 feet of the property line; the proposal omits it with a no-build easement of 4 feet by 47 feet 7 1/16 inches, giving 6 feet of clear width between the existing building and future construction.
The request says existing eaves are within 3 feet of the proposed line; the bay-window eave is 6 inches wide, and the porch on the east side has no cover or eave.
Drawing set cover (file 30980) states the project is lot confirmation and adjustment, wood-framed R-3, and the 2017 Oregon Residential Specialty Code.

Decision: omission of fire-rated construction within 3 feet is granted provided the easement is a minimum of 4 feet wide and 47 feet 7 and 1/16 inches long, starting 9 feet 7 and 3/16 inches from the west line, and BDS approves it before recording.
